# Lifecycle Rules (FlashArray REST API 2.58)

## GET `/api/2.58/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T0  

Returns a list of lifecycle rules. When `names` is specified, list the individual rules. When `ids` is specified, `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` is also required. When `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` are specified without `ids`, if there are at most 10 buckets with lifecycle rules in the system, list all the rules for the bucket, else it returns an error.

## POST `/api/2.58/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a lifecycle rule. `bucket` and `keep_previous_version_for` are required. If `rule_id` is not specified, it will be automatically generated in the format "faRuleIdX".

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `confirm_date` | query | boolean |  | If set to `true`, then confirm the date of `keep_current_version_until` is correct. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |

**Request body** (required): `_lifecycleRulePostBase`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `abort_incomplete_multipart_uploads_after` | integer (int64) | Duration of time after which incomplete multipart uploads will be aborted. Measured in milliseconds. Must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `keep_current_version_for` | integer (int64) | Time after which current versions will be marked expired. Measured in milliseconds. Must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `keep_current_version_until` | integer (int64) | Time after which current versions will be marked expired. Measured in milliseconds, time since epoch. Must be a valid date, accurate to day. |
| `keep_previous_version_for` | integer (int64) | The time in milliseconds after which previous versions are marked expired. Must be a multiple of 86400000 to represent a whole number of days. |
| `prefix` | string | The object key prefix identifying one or more objects in the bucket. The maximum length is 1024 characters. |
| `bucket` | `_referenceWithType` | The bucket targeted by the lifecycle rule. |
| `rule_id` | string | The identifier for the rule. It must be unique to the bucket. The maximum length is 255 characters. If not specified, an ID unique to the bucket is generated in the format `<platformName>RuleId<number>`, where… |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `LifecycleRuleResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/lifecycle-rules`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes individual lifecycle rules by name or id, or deletes all rules for a bucket. If `ids` is specified, `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` is also required. If `bucket_names` or `bucket_ids` are specified without `ids`, delete all the rules for the bucket.
